Results.ReviewText:
An outstanding grill! Some major improvements over the earlier Weber grill that I owned for over ten years!

Use anthracite lump charcoal, an electric element starter, mesquite wood chips (soaked in water then drained), and a drip pan centered on the lower grate. 

Slow cook regulating airflow (aka ‘mass flow rate’ 🌟) through the grill, and adding mesquite when 70% cooked. Prepare for a delicious meal—beef, poultry, fish, and smoked vegetables.

Grilling Tip: remove the dome as INFREQUENTLY as possible. Gourmet grilling is an art that requires patience and love for your family and guests. We advise not rushing the creative process. Simplify, Simplify, Simplify. 

No potentially dangerous gas tanks, no lugging empty gas cylinders, no traveling with full gas cylinders (probably without in-vehicle safety restraints) in your personal vehicle, no use of toxic liquid fire starting fluids.

When you are finished grilling, simply close the top and bottom air vents. Anthracite irregular-sized hard lump coal now starved of oxygen goes out reliably and safely.
Results.Title: Safe Gourmet Grilling

Results.ReviewText: Finally tried the new grill. Excellent!!! So glad I got it!!
Results.Title: Excellent!!

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Weber Original Kettle Premium Grill.  The first one was a gift, and we used it for over 10 years.  The old one finally failed, and we replaced it with this new one.  Really love how easy it is to use and how easy it is to control the temperature with the built in thermometer.  Only issues with the old one and eventually this new one is the built in ash scraper on the bottom rusts out and the aluminum legs/mounting tends to warp if your crazy brother-in-law puts in way too much charcoal!  But for another 10+ years of use, it is great.
Results.Title: Original Kettle Premium grill 22"

Results.ReviewText: It is a good grill with simple components.  The ash removal from the bottom is easy.  The heat guard for the handle is insufficient to protect your hand for more than a few seconds.  The hanger for the top is an internal hook designed to catch the edge of the bottom half of the grill.  I found this difficult to use and would prefer an external basket or shelf.

Results.ReviewText:
I’ve been eying this green version for years and I finally pulled the plug and got one. I grew up using Webers only ever owning Weber kettles. Never wanted to look at anything else cooks great food easy to use easy to assemble reliable durable until this one. The metal felt a little thinner the tolerances weren’t as snug but I let that go thinking I might be over thinking it, but after my first cook I noticed the the side handle was bending up and the enamel was chipping away at the seems. 


To put this in perspective I live in an 100 year old wooden house so I have to roll the grill through the yard to a safe distance to cook nothing difficult nothing I would expect any other Weber I’ve had to have problems with.

I did reach out to Weber and the team kindly sent me another kettle bowl to replace mine and it was a very good experience with customer service so I do appreciate that. I was dismayed though when I wheeled the grill out a bit to work on installing the new bowl the handle bent more and the lid went tumbling and got scuffed up. Which is a painful experience to someone like me who likes to keep the grill immaculate.


Over the years I learned to grill on a red 1970s kettle that lasted until 2010 the I had an 18 kettle and upgraded finally to this my dream grill I wish i could have afforded the performer though because at least I would still have a grill in good condition 


Weber please do better it’s what you are capable of that made this so disappointing.
Results.Title: What happened

Results.ReviewText: This Weber 22 inch grill is a huge upgrade from the 18 inch we have had for years.  Better charcoal baskets, better ash pan, and can be used with a rotisserie.  The grill baskets allow for efficient use of charcoal for slow cooking of large and small amounts of food, and great temperature control.  Overall a superior grill.
Results.Title: A superior charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: Still learning to use it. I can get it quite hot initially, but once I put food on the grill, I am barely able to maintain 300 degrees if that. I guess it just needs a lot more briquettes, but I already used 50 or 60.
Results.Title: Weber  charcoal kettle

Results.ReviewText: Gold standard for charcoal grills available. Can't beat it.
Results.Title: Best charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: Great meat flavor from cooking over charcoal.  Easy to control the heat level.
Results.Title: Taste

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
